title: Dự án Phát hiện Gian lận Thẻ tín dụng (Credit Card Fraud Detection)
summary: A credit card fraud detection project comparing Logistic Regression and XGBoost classifiers combined with several data resampling techniques to address extreme class imbalance. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, both instantiated via a SingleTableMetadata object, to generate synthetic minority-class fraud samples for oversampling.
